findings.title: AI workload identity has excessive GCP blast radius
findings.message: Likely AI/agent identity customer-agent@ai-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com holds broad role roles/owner in project ai-prod.
findings.remediation: Create a dedicated least-privilege service account for the AI workload; constrain projects, APIs, secrets and impersonation paths.

findings.title: Project Owner assignment
findings.message: customer-agent@ai-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com has Owner on GCP project ai-prod.
findings.remediation: Replace Owner with task-specific predefined/custom roles and use privileged access only when needed.

findings.title: User-managed service-account key detected
findings.message: Service account customer-agent@ai-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com has a user-managed key approximately 615 days old.
findings.remediation: Prefer Workload Identity Federation, metadata-based credentials or service-account impersonation; remove long-lived user-managed keys.

findings.title: AI workload identity has excessive GCP blast radius
findings.message: Likely AI/agent identity customer-agent@ai-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com holds broad role roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor in project ai-prod.
findings.remediation: Create a dedicated least-privilege service account for the AI workload; constrain projects, APIs, secrets and impersonation paths.

findings.title: Sensitive secret/decryption access
findings.message: customer-agent@ai-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com has sensitive data-access role roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor in project ai-prod.
findings.remediation: Scope secret/decryption access to exact workloads and resources; avoid project-wide grants for AI agents.
